newsitem.title: UK: Burton director cashes in options.
newsitem.headline: Burton director cashes in options.

text.p: An executive director of Burton Group Plc, the UK retailer, cashed in share options on Tuesday to finance a house purchase, said a company statement.
Director Terry Green excercised options for 1,677,609 ordinary shares of 10 pence each and sold 1,627,609 of the shares in the market, retaining 50,000 of the shares excercised under the options.
The option price for the shares varied from between 36.2 pence and 54.1 pence per share. The shares themselves were eventually sold at 157 pence per share.
